tuple-literal: ("(" ws ")") / ("(" ws expression ws "," ws [expression-list] ws ")")
dictionary-literal: "{" ws [(dictionary-entry *(ws "," ws dictionary-entry) [ws "," ws dictionary-spread]) / dictionary-spread] ws "}"
expression: annotated-expression / let-expression / recursive-let-expression / type-expression / newtype-expression / if-expression / match-expression / closure-expression / pipeline-expression
convergence-attribute: "#[" ws %s"unsafe" ws "(" ws %s"converges" ws "=" ws string-literal ws ")" ws "]"
operand: literal / reference-expression / grouped-expression / call-expression / field-expression / index-expression
let-expression: %s"let" gap binding *(ws "," ws binding) gap %s"in" gap expression
recursive-let-expression: %s"'let" gap binding *(ws "," ws binding) gap %s"in" gap expression
binding: *(convergence-attribute ws) (path / apostrophe-identifier / tuple-binding-pattern / struct-binding-pattern / list-pattern / dictionary-pattern) ws "=" ws expression
tuple-binding-pattern: ("(" ws ")") / ("(" ws binding-pattern ws "," ws [binding-pattern-list] ws ")")
declaration: *(convergence-attribute ws) (((%s"let" / %s"'let") gap binding) / (%s"type" gap type-binding) / (%s"newtype" gap type-binding))
type-binding: *(convergence-attribute ws) identifier [ws type-parameters] ws "=" ws type
if-expression: %s"if" gap expression gap %s"then" gap expression [gap %s"else" gap expression]
match-arm: pattern [gap %s"if" gap expression] ws "->" ws expression
pattern-primary: constructor-pattern / tuple-pattern / struct-pattern / list-pattern / dictionary-pattern / identifier / exclusion-pattern
tuple-pattern: ("(" ws ")") / ("(" ws pattern ws "," ws [pattern-list] ws ")")
list-pattern: "[" ws [pattern-list / (rest-pattern [ws "," ws pattern-list]) / (pattern-list ws "," ws rest-pattern)] ws "]"
closure-expression: [type-parameters ws] "(" ws [parameter-list [ws ","]] ws ")" [ws ":" ws type] ws "->" ws expression
operator-expression: (unary-operator ws operator-operand) / (operator-operand ws binary-operator ws operator-operand)
operator-operand: operand / annotated-expression / let-expression / recursive-let-expression / type-expression / newtype-expression / if-expression / match-expression / closure-expression / assertion-expression / is-expression
type-primary: type-reference / tuple-type / struct-type / ("(" ws type ws ")") / "!" / "?"
tuple-type: ("(" ws ")") / ("(" ws type ws "," ws [type-list] ws ")")
union-type: type-primary ws "|" ws type-primary *(ws "|" ws type-primary)
intersection-type: type-primary ws "&" ws type-primary *(ws "&" ws type-primary)
